PORT.description: serve: the port the web pages are served on.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, for the age of a run. Default: the clock.

CONSOLE_FOREMAN_URL.description: serve: the base URL of a foreman's API, or several, comma-separated, one per factory. Required.

CONSOLE_FOREMAN_TOKEN.description: serve: the foreman's FOREMAN_API_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>; several, comma-separated, in the order of CONSOLE_FOREMAN_URL, or one for all.

CONSOLE_INTAKE_URL.description: serve: the base URL of intake's API. Set, a run's page lists every request of its work item.

CONSOLE_GATEKEEPER_URL.description: serve: the base URL of gatekeeper's API. Set, a run's page shows each gate's state and who it waits for.

CONSOLE_TRACE_URL.description: serve: the link to a run's trace in the trace store, with {runId}, like https://langfuse.acme.dev/traces?run={runId}.

CONSOLE_SESSION_URL.description: serve: the link to a stage's transcript, with {sessionId}, like https://langfuse.acme.dev/sessions/{sessionId}.

CONSOLE_TEMPORAL_URL.description: serve: the base URL of the Temporal UI. Set, a run's page links its history.

CONSOLE_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.description: serve: the Temporal namespace of the runs, the foreman's FOREMAN_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE.

CONSOLE_LINKS.description: serve: the dashboards every page links, as name=url, comma-separated, like Grafana=https://grafana.acme.dev.

CONSOLE_REFRESH.description: serve: the seconds after which the browser reloads the runs pages.

CONSOLE_FACTORY.description: serve: the factory definition that /factory shows, read-only.

CONSOLE_FACTORY_PATH.description: serve: the path of the factory definition in its Git repository.

CONSOLE_REPOSITORY_URL.description: serve: the web URL of the factory's Git repository, like https://github.com/acme/factory. Set, the configuration pages link the file.

CONSOLE_BRANCH.description: serve: the branch where the factory definition changes.

CONSOLE_INBOX_REPOSITORY.description: serve: the repository of observer's pull requests, as <owner>/<name>, like acme/factory. Set, /inbox lists its open proposals.

CONSOLE_INBOX_PREFIX.description: serve: the start of the branch names that /inbox lists.

CONSOLE_FORGE_ADAPTER.description: serve: the command line of the forge port's adapter that /inbox runs with prs (ADR 0073).

CONSOLE_FORGE_URL.description: serve: the forge's API, the adapter's FORGE_URL, like https://codeberg.org for forge-forgejo. Default: the adapter's own.

CONSOLE_FORGE_TOKEN.description: serve: the adapter's FORGE_TOKEN; a token that may read pull requests is enough.
